headline_rule.even_profile: if all four measured skills fall within a one-band range -> headline = lower median band, labelled 'Indicative overall profile'
headline_rule.uneven_profile: if range across measured skills >= 2 bands -> suppress single headline; show 'Uneven profile' with full range
headline_rule.cap: headline never exceeds lowest measured skill + 1 band
headline_rule.prominence: individual skills always shown more prominently than the headline
headline_rule.foundation_only: if only LS+RD+LSN completed -> label 'Foundation and Receptive Profile'; never imply a four-skill overall level

confidence.Moderate: all required modules for that profile completed; no unresolved boundary; no material technical/integrity flag; cross-module pattern broadly coherent
confidence.Low: partial profile OR unresolved boundary OR non-monotonic pattern OR technical problem OR insufficient productive evidence OR multiple effort/integrity flags OR wide_window

allowed_wording: Skill profile and observed diagnostic gaps
Low/Moderate confidence based on completeness and flags
forbidden_wording: Reliability/accuracy percentages not supported by data

readiness_layer.principle: Exam names are descriptive destinations, not brands for GEPA. The placement test does not predict official exam scores. The layer explains whether general-English foundations appear sufficient to begin exam-specific preparation and which skill gaps deserve priority.

OET.safe_use: General-English foundation and skill gaps before profession-specific OET work
OET.never_claim: A guaranteed OET grade / 350 / 400 or regulator outcome
OET.currency_note: OET remains a four-subtest healthcare-specific assessment; GEPA describes general-English readiness only

IELTS.safe_use: Whether foundation English or mainly test-specific practice is likely to be needed

TOEFL iBT.safe_use: Readiness for TOEFL-specific academic and integrated-task practice
TOEFL iBT.never_claim: That GEPA CEFR equals an ETS 1-6 or 0-120 score
TOEFL iBT.currency_note: TOEFL iBT changed January 2026: 1-6 section/overall scale and multistage adaptive Reading/Listening

PTE Academic.currency_note: PTE added Summarize Group Discussion and Respond to a Situation from August 2025

Cambridge / DET / other.safe_use: Select an appropriate preparation level and focus areas
Cambridge / DET / other.never_claim: Official equivalence without a linking study

result_payload_sections: skill_profile (RD, LSN, SPK, WRT with band or 'not measured'/'insufficient evidence')
